summary: Comprehensive testing of PodcastHub MVP completed. Backend APIs 94.4% functional, frontend UI/UX 95%+ functional. Only critical issue is podcast upload failing due to external object storage service error.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 error when uploading podcast files
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks podcasters from uploading content, preventing platform content creation
critical_bugs.root_cause: External object storage service (integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore) returning 500 error
critical_bugs.error_details: HTTPError: 500 Server Error: Internal Server Error for url: https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/objects/podcasthub/podcasts/...

integration_issues.issue: No podcasts displayed on dashboard and browse pages
integration_issues.root_cause: Backend upload functionality failing, so no content available to display

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero section, features, and CTA buttons
Login functionality for users and podcasters
User dashboard with search and recommendations
Podcaster dashboard with Creator Studio and upload form UI
Browse page with search and category filtering
Navigation between pages and role-based routing
Podcast listing APIs (get all, search, filter, categories, trending)
Error handling for invalid credentials and unauthorized access
AI keyword extraction (8 keywords extracted for podcaster description)

success_percentage.frontend: 95%+ (all major flows working, minor display issue due to backend)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix object storage integration - the external storage service at integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore is returning 500 errors, preventing podcast uploads. This is the only critical blocker preventing full platform functionality.
